meta.how_to_use: Stages VP1-VP12 build the vendor area. VP1 sits on the provider plan's PP1 foundation; if the vendor area is scheduled first, PP1 is done under this plan instead. The recommended order (build_order) gets a seller live with a catalogue and answering inquiries before the import, AI and insight stages. Backend needs are listed in backend_requests with the same entry shape as the other frontend plans and join backend/BR-update-plan.json through its intake rules. When a proposal is accepted, set its status and record the decision in progress_log.

global_decisions.decision: The vendor portal is the route group /<locale>/vendor/... of the one business app at web.<DOMAIN> (WP20), beside /provider and the fleet pages, with the same BFF and OAuth client cp-web-portal, generated contract, design system and i18n (provider plan PRV-GD-01 and PP1). A hybrid provider+vendor organization sees both route groups after the organization switcher.
global_decisions.why: Docs/90 §3.3 and frontend/README.md: one business app with role-based routing. Components such as the review inbox, AI reply editor, approval card, team page and plan pages are built once for provider and vendor.

global_decisions.decision: Web-first, no separate compact app. The portal is designed for the counter desktop (≥ 1200 px: left navigation, master–detail, wide tables). The pages a seller opens from a push on the phone — inquiry list, inquiry detail with Reserve / Unavailable / Alternative / Complete, review approval answer, trade request decision — are built mobile-first and tested at 360 px. The rest only needs to work, not shine, on a phone.
global_decisions.why: Docs/12 persona: 'Desktop at the counter (vendor portal is web-first); her phone for notifications'. Unlike the Workshop PWA for mechanics, a parts shop has a computer; the phone's job is to answer an inquiry fast.

global_decisions.decision: The portal is installable as a PWA (manifest scope /<locale>/vendor/, name 'CarPal Parts' / «کارپال قطعات») with web push for new inquiries, reservation expiry, trade requests and review approval requests; in-app and email are the fallbacks. Business pushes never go to the consumer app.
global_decisions.why: Docs/90 line 141 and Docs/12 Ch.3 ('web push from the vendor portal installed as a PWA').

global_decisions.decision: Trade prices are shown only where they belong: the vendor's own inventory pages for roles allowed to see prices, and the trade price column of an inquiry from an approved trade customer. No preview, export, share link, page title, notification text or client log ever contains price_trade. The 'View as buyer' preview opens the public page (W-PUB-03 / W-PUB-08) as an anonymous visitor would see it.
global_decisions.why: Docs/12 'What she fears: competitors seeing her trade prices'; Docs/52 price_trade 'never exposed in public projections'; WP8 'search index documents never contain trade prices'.

global_decisions.decision: AI suggests, the vendor decides. Every AI output (normalised name, category, duplicate, fitment, review reply draft, demand gap) carries the AI suggestion label; nothing changes until a person accepts. AI fitment shows Likely or Uncertain until the vendor confirms; only fitment.decide or a vendor-entered confirmed row makes it Confirmed. When AI is off (vendor.ai_import.enabled, ENT(ai_tools_enabled) or the consent withdrawn) the import, inventory and fitment pages work without suggestions.
global_decisions.why: Docs/12 Ch.2, Docs/52 InventoryFitment rules, MVP §8.5 (no use of one vendor's data for another).

global_decisions.decision: Large catalogues stay fast: the inventory table is virtualised, paged through the cursor API, filters live in the URL, bulk selection works on the current filter ('select all 310 matching') through background jobs, and the browser never holds the whole catalogue. Budgets: first view of the inventory list ≤ 2.5 s with 10,000 items, row actions ≤ 300 ms perceived (optimistic with undo where the operation allows).
global_decisions.why: WP7 acceptance '10k-row import with progress and error report'; Mina has 3,400 lines and Kaveh edits stock every evening.

global_decisions.decision: The server decides access. Actions show by role (V* / V+ and the WP0 matrix), plan entitlements (max_inventory_items, inventory_bulk_import_enabled, ai_tools_enabled, advanced_analytics_enabled) and the inquiry's allowed transitions (Docs/40 §13.1 table). A 403 shows 'Ask the owner' for staff; an entitlement error shows the plan limit and the Pro trial offer.
global_decisions.why: Same rule as PRV-GD-03 and the fleet ?fleet option.

push_and_deep_links: Buyer replied, cancelled or marked 'I picked it up' → /vendor/inquiries/<id> (VND-BR-09)

build_order.why: A seller must exist (VP2) and have items (VP3, manual entry is the Must-have fallback) before anything else. Inquiries (VP6) and trade customers (VP7) come next because the buyer side is already live in the consumer PWA: garages and drivers can send 'Ask about part' today and need someone to answer. The bulk import (VP4) and AI queue (VP5) then make large catalogues practical. Profile, reviews, insights and team follow; VP12 closes with Mina's story end to end.
pilot_blockers_outside_this_plan: Web push sender in the backend (pwa DI-72 / OQ-26, provider plan PRV-BR-06): without it 'her phone buzzes' (Docs/12 Ch.6) falls back to email.
VND-BR-03 (reserved quantity and stock effects of inquiry transitions): without it Reserve does not lower public stock and the 3-star 'website said in stock' review of Ch.8 is the expected outcome.
VND-BR-01 (import preview): without it the import wizard cannot show validation before the import starts; the fallback runs import_create and shows errors only afterwards.

stages.title: Bulk import wizard and re-import by SKU
stages.goal: Mina's 3,412-row spreadsheet becomes 3,388 items with 24 skipped rows explained, while she keeps working; the weekly re-import updates quantities instead of creating duplicates.
rules: Steps 2-4 need VND-BR-01; until it lands the wizard reads only the header row in the browser for mapping (no row data leaves the upload), and validation shows after the import as the error report.
Mapping requires SKU, name and either a price column or the 'no price → Price on request' policy; 'Mapping incomplete' blocks Confirm.
Confirm shows the plan fit ('3,388 of 5,000 items used after this import') and ENT(inventory_bulk_import_enabled) failures as the Pro trial offer.
Progress is a background job: the wizard can be closed; the banner and the inventory.import_finished notification bring the vendor back to the results.
The error report downloads through the 5-minute signed URL; it is never rendered as HTML.
acceptance: 10,000-row file imports with progress and error report (WP7)
Wrong file type and empty file show 'File invalid' with the template
Re-import of the same file with changed quantities updates the items and creates none (after VND-BR-01)

stages.title: AI normalisation queue and fitment editor
stages.goal: Mina accepts most suggestions in bulk with Apply to similar items, rejects the oxygen-sensor merge, and confirms the Lemförder control arm for E90-E93 2005-2012.
operations: taxonomy reads (vehicle_brand, vehicle_model, vehicle_series, engine_type, fuel_type)
rules: Merge suggestions show both items side by side (SKU, part numbers, notes, images) before Accept; a rejection records feedback.
Fitment confidence labels: Confirmed (vendor), Likely (AI, pending), Uncertain (AI asks to check); only Confirm or a vendor-entered confirmed row produces Confirmed.
Apply to similar items always shows the count and a list before applying; it applies the same edit, not a new AI guess.
acceptance: No AI suggestion changes an item until accepted
With the consent withdrawn the queue is empty with an explanation and fitment editing still works
Keyboard-only review of 50 suggestions

stages.title: Inquiries: list, detail, reply, reserve, unavailable, alternative, complete, cancel — phone-ready
stages.goal: Mina reserves one control arm for Reza until Friday 12:00 from her phone after the push, in under a minute, and the public stock drops to 1; Kaveh completes it on Friday at the counter.
rules: Actions come from the §13.1 transition table for the vendor side; INVALID_TRANSITION (e.g. the buyer cancelled meanwhile) reloads the inquiry and says what changed.
Reserve needs a time ≤ 14 days ahead and a quantity (VND-BR-03); the reply text is prefilled ('Held for you until …') and editable.
Mark unavailable asks 'Also set this item to Out of stock?' (default yes) — one call with VND-BR-03, two calls before it.
Suggest alternative picks one of the vendor's own items and sends it as a part card (VND-BR-06); before it lands, the message carries the item's public link.
The vehicle context shows only brand, model, series, year and engine, and only when the requester shared it (CNS(vendor_fitment_context)); otherwise 'Vehicle not shared'.
First response time is shown on the list ('You usually reply in 25 min').
acceptance: Reza's Ch.6-7 path from a push on a 360 px phone and on desktop
The buyer side (pwa inquiry detail) shows reply, reservation, alternative and completion
A completed inquiry makes the buyer's review Verified purchase (inquiry_verified)

backend_requests.request: AiSuggestion carries group_key (same rule applied to similar raw values, e.g. the same category mapping or name pattern) and group_size; new ai.suggestions_decide_group POST {org}/ai/suggestions/groups/{group_key}/decision (ORG(V*), IDEM, AUD, ASYNC above 50) with the same SuggestionDecision, applied to every pending suggestion of the group.
backend_requests.why: Docs/90 V-INV-05 and Docs/12 Ch.2 'Apply to similar items'; ai.suggestion_decide takes one suggestion, so 3,000 suggestions would be 3,000 calls.

backend_requests.request: InventoryItem gets reserved_quantity (sum of active reservations) and available_quantity (derived); public projections and search show available_quantity. InquiryTransition to reserved takes reserved_quantity (default the inquiry quantity or 1, ≤ available); expiry (reserved_until passed), cancellation and unavailable release it; completed takes reduce_stock: boolean (default true) and subtracts the reserved or inquired quantity; unavailable takes set_item_out_of_stock: boolean. A scheduler expires reservations and moves the inquiry back to answered.
backend_requests.why: Docs/12 Ch.6 ('public stock count drops to 1', 'Mark Unavailable updates the item's stock to 0'), Ch.7 ('marks Completed and reduces stock'), the expiry rule in Ch.6 other paths, and Docs/12 open point 3. Docs/52 has no reserved quantity.

backend_requests.request: inventory.stock_bulk_set: POST {vnd}/inventory/stock (ORG(V*), IDEM) with { items: List<{ item_id; stock_quantity; stock_status?; etag? }, 500> } returning per-row results; stock_status derived from the quantity unless given.
backend_requests.why: Docs/12 Ch.4 'Kaveh updates stock in bulk every evening'; InventoryBulkUpdate can only set one stock_status for many items, not a quantity per item.

open_questions.question: Accept Excel (.xlsx) uploads in the import, or CSV only?
open_questions.default: CSV only in the MVP, with a template and a 'Save as CSV from Excel' help line in the wizard. XLSX parsing adds a large attack surface (SEC-IN-11 formula safety, zip bombs) to a public upload.
open_questions.trade_off: Most accounting exports open in Excel; some sellers will need one extra step.

open_questions.question: Vendor staff roles: keep vendor_owner + vendor_staff with a per-member permission set (inventory, inquiries, prices, reviews, settings), or add fixed roles (e.g. vendor_manager, vendor_counter)?
open_questions.default: Two roles plus a small permission set on the membership, decided in the WP0 matrix (VND-BR-05). It covers Kaveh without a new role and stays a narrowing of V*.

open_questions.question: Does a reservation lower the public stock count automatically (Docs/12 open point 3)?
open_questions.default: Yes, through reserved_quantity and available_quantity (VND-BR-03). Public pages show the available count; the vendor sees on hand, reserved and available.

open_questions.question: Keep 'Start with sample items' in V-ONB-03?
open_questions.default: No in the MVP: drop the option (manual add and upload cover the need) unless a sample set per category exists. VND-BR-11 is the path if yes.

open_questions.question: Who sets stock_status: the server from stock_quantity with a per-vendor low-stock threshold (default 3), or the vendor by hand?
open_questions.default: The server derives it when a quantity is given; the vendor can set 'available on request' by hand for items without a count.

open_questions.question: A separate compact phone app for sellers (like the Workshop PWA for mechanics)?
open_questions.default: No (VND-GD-02): the inquiry and approval pages are phone-ready inside the installable portal. Revisit if pilot sellers have no computer at the counter.

open_questions.question: Should completing an inquiry offer to send a review invitation to the buyer from the portal?
open_questions.default: Yes, as an optional checkbox on 'Mark completed' (review_invitations.send is V*), off by default so sellers do not spam; the buyer can review anyway from the completed inquiry.

open_questions.question: Name and manifest of the installed portal: 'CarPal Parts' / «کارپال قطعات», or 'CarPal Business' shared by provider and vendor?
open_questions.default: 'CarPal Parts' for the /vendor scope, so a hybrid organization's provider and vendor apps do not capture each other's links; WP0 approves.
